Kill [[Forgewight]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Forgewight in [[Slavers' Exile]].
* *BONUS* Kill Forgewight in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 2,500 [[Deldrimor rank|Dwarf reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 40 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
As per [[The Last Hierophant#Walkthrough|The Last Hierophant]].
